description: Build one Hytale pack under the desired manifest name, copy missing legacy assets without renaming any item/block IDs, migrate all affected world config keys with backup and rollback, and remove the retired packages only after verifying coverage.
changes: Retain 80 byte-identical Blackridge resources and 188 byte-identical 1.6.1 QA resources
Copy seven original Tall Wheat resource files into the pack; omit only its empty plugin class
Rename manifest to Zytale Buildings and Furnishment and update six world mod configurations
Install one global 1.7.0 JAR and remove the global Wheat JAR plus three obsolete local Blackridge packs
advantages: One mod name in the list
Old placed item/block IDs and asset paths remain valid
Other dependent saves are migrated before global Wheat removal
disadvantages: Manifest plugin identity changes and requires config migration
Headless smoke test cannot establish client rendering
A QUICHE native crash occurred after server startup
test_results: Byte-for-byte comparison covers all 80 old Blackridge resources and seven Tall Wheat resources
The 1.6.1 QA pack's 188 non-class resources are byte-identical in 1.7.0
Hytale 0.7.2 loaded and enabled the new pack and reached Universe ready in an isolated save
Post-install checks confirm one global JAR, old packages absent, six migrated configs and no stale lock files
